articles.title: Priyanka Chopra’s mother Dr Madhu remembers her days as an army doc: ‘These years shaped the way we raised Priyanka…’
articles.summary: Dr. Madhu Chopra, mother of Priyanka Chopra, shared a nostalgic photo with her late husband, Dr. Ashok Chopra, in their Indian Army medical officer uniforms. This revelation highlights their dedicated service to the nation as military doctors before their daughter's global fame. It offers an inspiring glimpse into the personal lives and commitment of defence personnel, a relevant aspect for SSB aspirants.

articles.title: TN to reiterate demand for Hosur airport as Defence Ministry rejects proposed sites
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu government will reiterate its demand for a greenfield airport in Hosur, an industrial town, following the Defence Ministry's rejection of previously proposed sites. This ongoing challenge underscores the complexities of infrastructure development, particularly when balancing civilian needs with defence restrictions. The state seeks to facilitate economic growth and connectivity for the region, pushing for a suitable site despite past setbacks related to military airspace concerns.
